def brief(res, label):
    if not res.ok:
        print(label,'ERR',res.output); return []
    insts = res.output['instances']
    items = insts.values() if isinstance(insts, dict) else insts
    rows=[]
    for i in items:
        if not isinstance(i, dict): continue
        b=i.get('world_bounds_m') or {}
        rows.append({'id':i.get('segmentation_id'),'px':i.get('pixel_count'),
                     'rgb':[round(v) for v in (i.get('rgb_median') or [0,0,0])],
                     'uv':[round(v,1) for v in (i.get('centroid_uv') or [0,0])],
                     'c':[round(v,3) for v in b.get('center',[])],
                     'mn':[round(v,3) for v in b.get('min',[])],
                     'mx':[round(v,3) for v in b.get('max',[])]})
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:-r['px'])
    print(label)
    for r in rows: print(r)
    return rows

def solve3(A,b):
    M=[A[i][:]+[b[i]] for i in range(3)]
    for c in range(3):
        p=max(range(c,3), key=lambda r: abs(M[r][c]))
        M[c],M[p]=M[p],M[c]
        if abs(M[c][c])<1e-12: return None
        for r in range(3):
            if r!=c:
                f=M[r][c]/M[c][c]
                for k in range(c,4): M[r][k]-=f*M[c][k]
    return [M[i][3]/M[i][i] for i in range(3)]

def st():
    return primitives.call(name='observe_maniskill_control_state').output
def pnow(): return st()['tcp_pose']['p'][0]
def apost(dq,grip):
    a=[0.0]*8
    for j in range(7): a[j]=dq[j]
    a[7]=grip
    return primitives.call(name='apply_maniskill_action', action=a, repeat=4)

# gripper sign test
primitives.call(name='apply_maniskill_action', action=[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1.0], repeat=6)
gpos=st()['qpos'][0][7]
primitives.call(name='apply_maniskill_action', action=[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,-1.0], repeat=6)
gneg=st()['qpos'][0][7]
opensign = 1.0 if gpos>gneg else -1.0
print('gpos',round(gpos,4),'gneg',round(gneg,4),'opensign',opensign)

def jac():
    base=st()['tcp_pose']['p'][0][:]
    J=[[0.0]*7 for _ in range(3)]
    for j in range(7):
        a=[0.0]*8; a[j]=0.4
        primitives.call(name='apply_maniskill_action', action=a, repeat=5)
        p=st()['tcp_pose']['p'][0]
        for k in range(3): J[k][j]=(p[k]-base[k])/0.4
        base=p[:]
    return J

def move_to(tgt, iters=14, tol=0.01, ms=0.6, lam=0.003, grip=-0.6):
    J=jac()
    p=None
    for it in range(iters):
        p=st()['tcp_pose']['p'][0]
        err=[tgt[k]-p[k] for k in range(3)]
        if max(abs(e) for e in err)<tol: return True,p
        err=[max(-0.025,min(0.025,e)) for e in err]
        A=[[sum(J[k][j]*J[m][j] for j in range(7))+(lam if k==m else 0.0) for m in range(3)] for k in range(3)]
        y=solve3(A,err)
        if y is None: return False,p
        dq=[sum(J[k][j]*y[k] for k in range(3)) for j in range(7)]
        mx=max(abs(v) for v in dq)
        if mx>ms: dq=[v*ms/mx for v in dq]
        apost(dq, grip)
    return False, st()['tcp_pose']['p'][0]
